title: Olive's Gift in the Box
note: b417 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations u as yoo, c as s, g as j.

pages.brief: Olive the owl perched on a windowsill, looking down at a small wooden box filled with soil and flowers.
Olive the owl looking thoughtfully at the flower box, an idea forming.
Olive the owl gently plucking a single bright pink petal from a flower in the box.
Olive the owl picking a small green leaf from the same flower box.
Olive the owl placing the bright petal carefully on top of the green leaf.
Olive the owl wrapping a thin plant stem around the leaf and petal to hold them together.
A small, neat bundle of petal and leaf tied with a stem, resting on the windowsill.
Olive the owl flying with the small gift held carefully, Nell the bee waiting below.
Nell the bee smiling widely as Olive presents the little petal gift to her.
Olive the owl and Nell the bee together, both happy, the gift held between them.
